assets.name: MIRI’S VILLAGE
assets.prompt: Warm, stylized 3D storybook animation (feature-film CG), soft global illumination, gentle natural light, rich hand-crafted textures, HD, rich details, heartfelt tone with light comedy. Empty ancient village morning plate, composed with rule of thirds. Dark foreground frame made by the shaded edges of clay walls and hanging reed mats; clear midground of warm clay homes, woven baskets, straw piles, a clay oven, water jars, and a low wall; misty distance with soft rooftops, hills, and pale golden sunlight spilling between buildings. A few goats nose through straw in the midground. Materials are rounded sunbaked clay, woven reed, rough linen, dusty stone, and warm earth. Palette of 60% honeyed clay ochre, 30% soft sand and linen cream, 10% muted teal and fig-leaf green.
assets.notes: Keep the plate empty of people while preserving lived-in village detail. Watch depth: foreground shadow, readable midground, misty background.
